tools.name: whatsapp_pricing
tools.description: Free. Lists the USDC price of every paid tool and how x402 pay-per-call works on this server. Call this first to budget a task.

tools.name: whatsapp_number_lookup
tools.description: Look up detailed WhatsApp information for a phone number. Returns profile data, about text, business profile, picture history, and optional enrichments like Telegram, Google results, data leak checks, LinkedIn profiles matched by phone, carrier info, AI face analysis, and reverse image search. x402

tools.name: whatsapp_number_simple_check
tools.description: Quickly check if a phone number is registered on WhatsApp. Faster than full lookup — returns basic registration status without fetching profile picture or enrichments. x402 price: $0.01 USDC per call.

tools.name: whatsapp_phone_pagination
tools.description: Browse the WhatsApp phone numbers database with pagination. Returns paginated results sorted by date (newest first) or by number. Supports basic text search, country code filtering, and date-range filtering (dateFrom / dateTo accept ISO 8601 dates, e.g. "2024-01-01"). x402 price: $0.01 USDC per call

tools.name: whatsapp_phone_search
tools.description: Advanced search across the WhatsApp phone numbers database. Supports text search, country filtering, business status, profile picture presence, date range filtering, and AI face analysis attributes (gender, age, ethnicity, glasses, beard, tags). x402 price: $0.01 USDC per call.

tools.name: whatsapp_phone_details
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific phone number from the database. Returns stored profile data without making live WhatsApp checks. Optionally includes the full modification history of the entry. x402 price: $0.01 USDC per call.

tools.name: whatsapp_phone_stats
tools.description: Retrieve aggregate statistics about the WhatsApp phone numbers database. Returns total record count, country distribution, business vs personal accounts, and other high-level metrics. Uses cached data for fast responses. x402 price: $0.01 USDC per call.

tools.name: whatsapp_bulk_check_db
tools.description: Check multiple phone numbers against the WhatsApp database. Returns whether each number exists in the DB, its validation status, and basic info. Does NOT make live WhatsApp checks. Max 1000 numbers per request. x402 price: $0.002 USDC per number (min $0.01).

tools.name: whatsapp_bulk_check_live
tools.description: Live bulk check of phone numbers against WhatsApp servers. Verifies each number's actual WhatsApp registration status in real-time. More accurate than DB check but slower. Max 50 numbers per request. Returns WhatsApp status, ban status, business info, and formatted phone details. x402 price: $0.01 U

tools.name: whatsapp_carrier_lookup
tools.description: Look up the phone carrier/operator for a given phone number. Returns the carrier name, line type (mobile/landline), and country. x402 price: $0.01 USDC per call.

tools.name: whatsapp_profile_picture
tools.description: Get the WhatsApp profile picture for a phone number. Returns the CDN URL where the image can be accessed. Use whatsapp_number_lookup for the full profile including picture history. x402 price: $0.02 USDC per call.

tools.name: whatsapp_telegram_check
tools.description: Check if one or more phone numbers are registered on Telegram. Returns registration status and available Telegram profile data for each number. x402 price: $0.01 USDC per number (min $0.01).

tools.name: whatsapp_google_search
tools.description: Search Google for publicly available information associated with a phone number. Returns search results mentioning the phone number from across the web. x402 price: $0.02 USDC per call.

tools.name: whatsapp_face_analysis
tools.description: Run AI-powered face analysis on a WhatsApp profile picture using Gemini AI. Detects faces and estimates age, gender, ethnicity, and attributes (glasses, beard, etc). Requires the number to have a profile picture in the database. x402 price: $0.05 USDC per call.

tools.name: whatsapp_osint_info
tools.description: Get OSINT (Open Source Intelligence) information for a phone number. Returns WhatsApp registration status, device information, business profile details, and other publicly available intelligence. Uses a different detection method than the standard number lookup. x402 price: $0.02 USDC per call.

tools.name: whatsapp_leak_check
tools.description: Check if a phone number appears in known data breaches and leaks. Returns information about any breaches where the phone number was found, including breach sources and exposed data types. x402 price: $0.05 USDC per call.

tools.name: whatsapp_business_address_search
tools.description: Search for WhatsApp Business accounts that have physical addresses registered. Returns paginated results with business profile details including address, description, categories, email, and website. x402 price: $0.01 USDC per call.

tools.name: whatsapp_proximity_search
tools.description: Search for WhatsApp Business accounts near a geographic location. Provide latitude, longitude, and a search radius in kilometers to find businesses with registered addresses within the specified area. x402 price: $0.01 USDC per call.

tools.name: whatsapp_system_status
tools.description: Check the overall system health of the WhatsApp Data API. Returns service availability, working/broken instances, error rates, and uptime info. Useful for diagnosing issues before running other tools.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: whatsapp_profile_picture, whatsapp_business_address_search, whatsapp_system_status · Private data: whatsapp_phone_pagination, whatsapp_phone_search, whatsapp_phone_details, whatsapp_phone_stats, whatsapp_bulk_check_db, whatsapp_bulk_check_live, whatsapp_face_analysis · Public sink: whatsapp_business_address_search · Destructive: whatsapp_face_analysis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: whatsapp_profile_picture, whatsapp_business_address_search, whatsapp_system_status · Private data: whatsapp_phone_pagination, whatsapp_phone_search, whatsapp_phone_details, whatsapp_phone_stats, whatsapp_bulk_check_db, whatsapp_bulk_check_live, whatsapp_face_analysis · Public sink: whatsapp_business_address_search · Destructive: whatsapp_face_analysis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
